name: city_building_add_remove
description: Instantly add a completed building to a city (no production, no district placement choice needed - it goes into its district automatically), or remove a building a city already has, or just check. Uses City:GetBuildQueue():CreateIncompleteBuilding(buildingIndex, 100) and City:GetBuildings():RemoveBuilding + BuildQueue:RemoveBuilding in GameCore_Tuner (Firaxis Debug/City.ltp building list). Verified live turn 60: Monument in Kraków HasBuilding false -> true, culture 2.2 -> 4.2, then removed back to false / 2.2. A percentage below 100 returned false and did nothing. Buildings that need a plot choice (wonders, RequiresPlacement=true) are not handled here. Params: cityId (required), building (BUILDING_* type, required), action ("add" default | "remove" | "check"), playerId (city owner, default local player). Returns HasBuilding before/after, the city's building list and culture/production/science yields.
lua:
local pid = P.playerId or Game.GetLocalPlayer()
local pl = Players[pid]
if not pl then emitJson({error="no player "..tostring(pid)}); return end
local c = pl:GetCities():FindID(P.cityId)
if not c then emitJson({error="no city "..tostring(P.cityId).." for player "..tostring(pid)}); return end
local row = GameInfo.Buildings[P.building]
if not row then emitJson({error="unknown building "..tostring(P.building)}); return end
local action = P.action or "add"
local b = c:GetBuildings()
local before = b:HasBuilding(row.Index)
local ret = nil
if action == "add" then
  if before then ret = "already present"
  elseif row.RequiresPlacement then ret = "refused: building requires plot placement (wonder)"
  else ret = tostring(c:GetBuildQueue():CreateIncompleteBuilding(row.Index, 100)) end
elseif action == "remove" then
  if not before then ret = "not present"
  else b:RemoveBuilding(row.Index); c:GetBuildQueue():RemoveBuilding(row.Index); ret = "removed" end
else ret = "check only" end
local after = b:HasBuilding(row.Index)
local list = {}
for r in GameInfo.Buildings() do if b:HasBuilding(r.Index) then table.insert(list, r.BuildingType) end end
emitJson({city=c:GetName(), building=row.BuildingType, action=action, result=ret, hadBefore=before, hasAfter=after, buildings=list, yields={production=c:GetYield(1), science=c:GetYield(3), culture=c:GetYield(4), gold=c:GetYield(2), faith=c:GetYield(5)}})
